children: shares rose about 2.5% in premarket trading Thursday after the company outlined a long-term growth strategy and financial framework, including plans to generate as much as $1.4 billion in cumulative free cash flow through fiscal 2030.

The outdoor-products maker said at its investor day that it expects annual net sales growth in the mid-single-digit to high-single-digit range through 2030, while adjusted operating income is expected to grow at a high-single-digit to low-double-digit rate. Adjusted EPS growth is expected in the low-double-digit to high-teens range.

also said it expects cumulative free cash flow of about $1.3 billion at the midpoint over the five-year period ending in fiscal 2030, with the majority of excess cash expected to be returned to shareholders through share repurchases.
The company identified Bags & Soft Coolers as its next billion-dollar product platform and aims to generate $1 billion in international sales.

reiterated its fiscal 2026 outlook, including about a 7.5% sales growth, 11% adjusted operating income growth, and adjusted EPS of $2.97 at the midpoints. The company expects an adjusted operating income margin of 14.9%, free cash flow of $212.5 million, and capital expenditures of $65 million at the midpoints.

title: YETI outlines growth plans as it keeps 2026 forecast unchanged
